description: This file defines the AzureAssistantsAPI class, which provides methods to manage Azure OpenAI assistants, including creating, retrieving, deleting assistants, and managing threads and messages within those assistants. It supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations and interacts with external Azure OpenAI SDKs.

classes.name: AzureAssistantsAPI
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage Azure OpenAI assistants, including creation, retrieval, deletion, and thread/message management, supporting both sync and async operations.

methods.name: get_azure_client
methods.description: Initializes and returns an AzureOpenAI client, either sync or async, based on parameters.

methods.name: async_get_azure_client
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and returns an AsyncAzureOpenAI client.

methods.name: async_get_assistants
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a list of assistants.

methods.name: get_assistants
methods.description: Retrieves a list of assistants, either synchronously or asynchronously based on parameters.

methods.name: a_add_message
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a message to a thread.

methods.name: add_message
methods.description: Adds a message to a thread, supporting both sync and async operations.

methods.name: async_get_messages
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves messages from a thread.

methods.name: get_messages
methods.description: Retrieves messages from a thread, either sync or async.

methods.name: async_create_thread
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new thread.

methods.name: create_thread
methods.description: Creates a new thread, supporting both sync and async.

methods.name: async_get_thread
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a thread by ID.

methods.name: get_thread
methods.description: Retrieves a thread by ID, either sync or async.

methods.name: arun_thread
methods.description: Asynchronously runs a thread with polling.

methods.name: async_run_thread_stream
methods.description: Streams the execution of a thread asynchronously.

methods.name: run_thread_stream
methods.description: Streams the execution of a thread synchronously.

methods.name: run_thread
methods.description: Runs a thread, supporting both sync and async, with options for streaming and polling.

methods.name: async_create_assistants
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new assistant.

methods.name: create_assistants
methods.description: Creates a new assistant, supporting both sync and async.

methods.name: async_delete_assistant
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes an assistant.

methods.name: delete_assistant
methods.description: Deletes an assistant, supporting both sync and async.
